family_name: Polyair Thermo Reflective Products - Polyair Unicell Self Adhesive

spec.description:
Bradford Polyair Unicell Self Adhesive is an
extra heavy duty, commercial-grade thermo-reflective insulation roll featuring
an integrated self-adhesive lap tape system with a peel-off release liner.
Engineered with an inner fire-retardant bubble core laminated between dual
reflective aluminum foil layers, the self-adhesive edge streamlines on-site
joining, eliminating the need for a second installer to hold tapes during lap
sealing. It reflects up to 95% of radiant heat, controls condensation on metal
surfaces, and forms an airtight weather barrier in shed and residential roofs
and walls.
features:
Integrated self-adhesive lap tape with release liner
for streamlined, rapid installation

Extra heavy duty commercial-grade
reflective insulation roll

Fire-retardant bubble cell core provides
structural handling stability

Reflects up to 95% of radiant heat in summer
and retains warmth in winter

Self-adhesive edge ensures tight, clean, and
durable overlap seals without loose tape

Forms a continuous weather, air, and
moisture barrier when sealed

Dramatically reduces condensation dripping from
underside of metal roof sheeting

Extra heavy duty puncture and tear
resistance

technical.value:
Fire-retardant bubble core with dual aluminum
foil facings and integrated self-adhesive lap tape
1350 mm width x 40 m length (54 m²)

range.size_or_rating: 4 mm x 1350 mm x 40 m (54 m²)

spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Suitable for BAL-12.5 to
BAL-40 to AS 3959
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1, AS/NZS 4200.2, AS 1530.2,
AS 3959, NCC Volume One & Two
spec.sustainability:
Zero ODP; low VOC emissions;
fiber-free non-toxic core
install:
Roll out Polyair Unicell Self Adhesive
across roof purlins or wall framing

Position adjoining roll so its edge
aligns over the self-adhesive lap margin

Peel back the protective release
liner along the self-adhesive strip progressively

Press the overlapping sheet
firmly down onto the exposed adhesive strip

Smooth out using a squeegee or
hand roller to ensure a complete, airtight seal

Fasten metal sheeting over
the insulation into purlins or studs
selection_checklist:
Confirm
requirement for self-adhesive lap feature to reduce labor and extra taping
Measure total roof and wall area allowing for lap coverage (54m² per roll)
Verify air gap requirement (minimum 20mm) to achieve thermal R-value

Order
end-lap sealing tape for transverse cut ends
limitations:
Self-adhesive strip is on longitudinal edge; transverse end
cuts still require separate foil tape

Surfaces must be dry and free of dust
for the self-adhesive lap to bond properly

Requires minimum 20mm air space to
deliver rated system R-values

Backed by CSR Bradford product
warranty
